deploy-bot: Starting wave-43: api/runtime/console/router deploy in change-window 03:00-04:00Z. initial canary 5%. :rocket:

maya: Heads-up: api token prefix changing 'rwd:' -> 'rw:' to save bytes. runtime needs v4 patch to accept both prefixes. console will start emitting new prefix next build.

rick: need compatibility window and rollback criteria. clients may still send old prefix.

liang: propose runtime pin to v3.9.7 for the wave so it accepts both. router hold validation flag off until we confirm console live.

sofia: i'll run smoke tests (mix old/new prefixes) and post results.

deploy-bot: Pin command running:
```
/deploy pin runtime v3.9.7 --wave wave-43 --reason "auth prefix compatibility"
```

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 10%, observability hooks active.

rick: rollback triggers: auth 401/403 > 0.5% sustained 5m OR p99 latency +300ms 5m -> immediate rollback.

sofia: smoke test (200 reqs, 70/30 old/new) -> 199 successes (99.5%). fallback accepted one old token. logs attached. :white_check_mark:

maya: confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood/releases/wave-43/auth-prefix (published). client note pushed to support.

liang: checklist met. router team can flip validation with staged rollout 5,25,75,100.

tom: runtime pin hold for 2 hours post-router full roll, then upgrade to v4.0.0 if stable.

deploy-bot: Scheduling router rollout:
```
/deploy roll router v2.13.0 --stages 5,25,75,100 --wave wave-43 --flag enable-auth-strict=true
```

rick: obs team watch auth 4xx/5xx for 30m and escalate to #eng-oncall on anomalies.

deploy-bot: wave-43 status: in-progress; runtime pinned v3.9.7; router rolling v2.13.0 (stage 5%).
